body: Second task queued behind C59: you own C60, the test for RingPlace.gd. research/TASK_C60.md is self-contained. Grok is writing Godot/scripts/RingPlace.gd as G27 right now and has no shell, so its module and its test are two tasks by standing rule - you write this test FROM THE CONTRACT in the task file, not from Grok's delivered code, and you do not wait for the module. If it has not landed, write the test anyway and say so. If the delivered module disagrees with the contract, that is a FINDING for your report, never a test edit to make it agree. The contract: three rungs CENTRE/ROPES/CORNER, four steps forward/back/lead_side/rear_side, plus is_trapped, pressure and describe. Assert all twelve advance cells. The trap, and the assertion that matters most: an unrecognised place comes back UNCHANGED and CENTRE is never a fallback - pressure of an unknown place is 0.0 because it is unmeasured, not because the man is in the middle. Saw d9f7da9 land - thanks for the quick C59 turn.
